商业信息Commercial Information

上线前审核提示Pre-launch review notice

本页为运营草案。尚未提供的法定公司资料不会被推定或虚构，必须在公开上线前由企业和法律顾问确认。This page is an operational draft. Missing legal company information is neither assumed nor fabricated and must be confirmed by the company and its legal adviser before public launch.

询价性质Nature of inquiries

网站表单用于提交非约束性商业询价或考察申请。点击发送将通过 EmailJS 发送给授权业务接收方；您也可自行通过 WhatsApp 或微信发送准备好的消息。提交不构成订单接受、供货承诺、考察确认或正式报价。The website forms submit non-binding quotation or visit requests. Clicking send transmits the request through EmailJS to authorized business recipients; you may alternatively send a prepared message through WhatsApp or WeChat. Submission does not constitute order acceptance, a supply commitment, visit confirmation or a formal quotation.

价格与汇率Prices and exchange rates

人民币价格为人工维护的批发参考价格，可根据订购数量协商。美元和欧元等值根据欧洲央行参考汇率自动换算，仅供参考；如汇率服务暂不可用，则显示最近一次有效汇率（并标明日期）或人工设定的参考值。最终报价以美元确认，除非报价另有说明，正式报价有效期为 15 天。CNY prices are indicative wholesale reference prices maintained manually and negotiable according to order volume. USD and EUR equivalents are converted automatically from European Central Bank reference rates for information only; if the rate service is unavailable, the last valid rate (with its date) or manually set reference values are shown. Final quotations are confirmed in USD and remain valid for 15 days unless the quotation states otherwise.

交付与费用Delivery and costs

适用的 Incoterm 必须在报价中确认。网站所示出口价格不包含国际运费、适用的国际运输保险、中国清关、关税、进口税费或送达买方中国仓库的费用。The applicable Incoterm must be confirmed in the quotation. Displayed export prices exclude international freight, applicable transport insurance, Chinese customs clearance, duties, import taxes, and delivery to the buyer’s warehouse in China.

文件与供应Documents and supply

商业发票、装箱单、原产地证书、质量控制资料及出口或海关文件，仅在确认可取得且适用后提供。批次来源、装柜方案和全部商业条件均以最终文件为准。Commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, quality-control records, and export or customs documents are provided only when confirmed available and applicable. Lot origin, loading plans, and all commercial terms remain subject to final documentation.
